annotations.title: List the small models a recipe can call

description: Lists the small models this deployment serves to recipes, by task: classify (label each row of a text column with yes/no or choice questions), extract (pull named, verbatim-grounded fields out of page or document text), match (link the same entity across tables; planned until it is served), observe (measure activity at a place from free satellite data, one request per place by lat and lon, a time series back) and predict (predict a column for rows where it is unknown from rows where it is known, with a tabular model Mostly Right runs). Returns {tasks: [{task, status, what, bindings, note?}], headline, reference}; headline names each task and its state in one line to say first. status is available, not_served, planned or unknown. Each binding carries its route (origin, method, path), its pinned model, max_requests_per_second, usage_today, quota, and a request_template for a per-row source: copy origin, method, path_template and model exactly, because the platform credential is chosen by that route and pin. Each also carries a pages_template (request_timeout_seconds 120, retries 3) to write into the collection's pages: the model service scales to zero and can take three to five minutes to start, and the run waits that out. An observe binding's pages_template also carries revisit (an interval of 518400 seconds) so each rebuild asks every place again and its series keeps growing. A predict binding instead carries predict_limits, the ceilings its rows and features must fit, and calls_left_today (0 means today's allowance is spent, and the task's note says so), and its request_template is a whole predict source to start from that reads one sibling, beside a prepare_template that prepares its rows from several siblings with one SELECT, both with no pages_template. A binding with for_recipes false is listed for completeness and never written into a recipe. The person enrols no key and pays nothing for these calls. Call it once per conversation before the brief, and offer what it lists where the table would gain from it; the build skill's references/enriching-with-small-models.md says when. Next: suggest_enrichments after a run.
